mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notify_message (target_user_id, category, title, content, biz_type, biz_id, read_flag) VALUES (#{targetUserId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notify_message WHERE target_user_id = #{uid} OR target_user_id IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
